title: The Regulation of Hypoxia Inducible Factor (HIF)1alpha Expression by Quercetin: an In Silico Study.
authors: Wahyuningsih, Sri Puji Astuti; Dewi, Firli Rahmah Primula; Hsan, Amy Saik Yi; Lee, Looi Mee; Lim, Vuanghao; Aun, Lionel In Lian; Ling, Tau Chuan; Marviella, Sephia Tiara
journal: Acta informatica medica : AIM : journal of the Society for Medical Informatics of Bosnia & Herzegovina : casopis Drustva za medicinsku informatiku BiH
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接模拟槲皮素对HIF1alpha转录因子与其降解相关蛋白互作的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA体系但聚焦蛋白-蛋白降解互作而非DNA结合，方法为对接模拟，与本课题部分相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cancer disease is a growing health problem in developing and developed countries. Hypoxia-inducible factor-1a (HIF1alpha) is a transcription factor responsible for expressing several proteins involved in angiogenesis. Quercetin can suppress HIF1alpha expression due to the inhibition of protein synthesis. However, to date, the study exploring the potential of quercetin in repressing HIF1alpha through its degradation mechanism has never been done. An in silico study is needed as a preliminary study to understand the mechanism underlining this possibility. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate the potential of quercetin in regulating HIF1alpha expression through the ubiquitin degradation pathway by in silico study. METHODS: This study was performed by in silico analysis, including biological activity prediction, 3D protein structure collection, protein-ligand and protein-protein docking, and the visualization of the docking results. RESULTS: The probability activity (Pa) score of quercetin as an HIF1alpha expression inhibitor was 0.969. In the absence of quercetin, the center-weighted score of HIF1alpha - pVHL, HIF1alpha - FIH, and HIF1alpha - PHD2 was -699.4 kJ/mol, -846.0 kJ/mol, and -650.5 kJ/mol, respectively. In the presence of quercetin, the weighted score of HIF1alpha - pVHL, HIF1alpha - FIH, and HIF1alpha - PHD2 was reduced to -728.1 kJ/mol, -854.2 kJ/mol, and -650.5 kJ/mol, respectively. CONCLUSION: Quercetin could directly promote HIF1alpha and pVHL interaction, thus increasing the degradation of HIF1alpha by ubiquitin-dependent pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：癌症疾病在发展中国家和发达国家都是一个日益严重的健康问题。缺氧诱导因子-1a（HIF1alpha）是一种转录因子，负责表达多种参与血管生成的蛋白质。槲皮素可通过抑制蛋白质合成来抑制HIF1alpha的表达。然而，迄今为止，尚未有研究探讨槲皮素通过其降解机制抑制HIF1alpha的潜力。需要进行一项计算机模拟研究作为初步研究，以理解这一可能性背后的机制。目的：本研究旨在通过计算机模拟研究，探讨槲皮素通过泛素降解途径调节HIF1alpha表达的潜力。方法：本研究通过计算机模拟分析进行，包括生物活性预测、3D蛋白质结构收集、蛋白质-配体和蛋白质-蛋白质对接，以及对接结果的可视化。结果：槲皮素作为HIF1alpha表达抑制剂的概率活性（Pa）评分为0.969。在无槲皮素的情况下，HIF1alpha - pVHL、HIF1alpha - FIH和HIF1alpha - PHD2的中心加权评分分别为-699.4 kJ/mol、-846.0 kJ/mol和-650.5 kJ/mol。在存在槲皮素的情况下，HIF1alpha - pVHL、HIF1alpha - FIH和HIF1alpha - PHD2的加权评分分别降至-728.1 kJ/mol、-854.2 kJ/mol和-650.5 kJ/mol。结论：槲皮素可直接促进HIF1alpha与pVHL的相互作用，从而通过泛素依赖性途径增加HIF1alpha的降解。
